name: Lucento web · Horizon
note: Source of truth for the website's visual system (concept B 'Horizon', chosen by the owner 2026-11-07). Same shape as lucento-website/design/tokens.json so build-tokens.mjs can emit it; that file stays the app's own palette (used by the phone demo). Run `node system/build.mjs` after editing: it writes lab/system/tokens.css, system/CONTRAST.md, the DESIGN.md frontmatter and .impeccable/design.json.

crest-blue.note: OKLCH hue 265 at every step; chroma tapers to the ends. 600 is the logo's first crest bar. The app's ElectricBlue #3563F5 sits between 500 and 600 and Lottie's #2563EB beside it, so screenshots and the site read as one family.

tokens.name: color-paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Day is the app's Soft Ivory; Night matches the midnight panorama's sky and foot, so the band has no seam.

tokens.name: color-sky
tokens.usage: Top of the hero sky gradient.

tokens.name: color-haze
tokens.usage: Bottom of the hero sky; equals the panorama's top row so the scenery rises out of the sky with no edge.

tokens.name: color-card
tokens.usage: Discrete objects only: plan cards, the horizon chart, tables. Night uses the app's NightSurface.

tokens.name: color-raised
tokens.usage: Something on a card: the open disclosure, a table header. Night lifts by tone, not shadow.

tokens.name: color-dusk
tokens.usage: End of the page's day: the plans band fades paper → dusk. Day is the app's Sunlight Pale; Night is a faint moonlit navy.

tokens.name: color-ink
tokens.usage: Headings, body text, the horizon line in Day. Midnight Navy / NightInk from the app.

tokens.name: color-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting text, captions, fine print. ≥ 5.7:1 on every Day surface, ≥ 7.7:1 on every Night surface.

tokens.name: color-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines that only group: card edges, list dividers. Never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: color-line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that carry meaning (the secondary button, table rules, the chart's axis notes). ≥ 3:1 on paper and card.

tokens.name: color-horizon
tokens.usage: The horizon line: the zero line of the chart and the one structural rule of the system.

tokens.name: color-action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, the Pro plan. Blue means 'act' (or 'have' in the chart); nothing else is filled blue.

tokens.name: color-action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: color-action-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button while pressed.

tokens.name: color-on-action
tokens.usage: Text on the action fill: 5.98:1 Day, 6.98:1 Night.

tokens.name: color-on-action-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the action fill (the Pro card's details).

tokens.name: color-link
tokens.usage: Text links, the secondary button's label and edge.

tokens.name: color-link-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover.

tokens.name: color-tint
tokens.usage: A quiet blue surface: hover wash on the secondary button, the highlighted column of the plan table.

tokens.name: color-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring (3px, offset 3px). ≥ 3:1 against paper and card in both themes.

tokens.name: color-sun
tokens.usage: The light: the sun marker (net worth), fact bullets, the Play-status dot. Decorative only; never text, never status.

tokens.name: color-dawn
tokens.usage: The sun's halo and warm edges. Decorative only.

tokens.name: color-have
tokens.usage: Chart: what you have, above the horizon.

tokens.name: color-owe
tokens.usage: Chart: what you owe, below the horizon. Calm slate, not alarm red; ≥ 3.3:1 on its card. Position carries the meaning, the label states it.

tokens.name: color-positive
tokens.usage: Money in, as text, always with a + sign. App PositiveText / PositiveNight.

tokens.name: color-negative
tokens.usage: Money spent (flows), as text, always with a − (U+2212) sign. Balances you owe are written with − in ink, not red. App NegativeText / night error.

tokens.name: color-crest-1
tokens.usage: Logo bar 1. Logo only.

tokens.name: color-crest-2
tokens.usage: Logo bar 2. Logo only.

tokens.name: color-crest-3
tokens.usage: Logo bar 3. Logo only.

tokens.name: color-crest-sun
tokens.usage: Logo sun. Logo only.

tokens.name: color-device
tokens.usage: Phone frame bezel: light, so the dark app screens stand out from it on day and night grounds (owner, 2026-11-08).

tokens.name: color-device-edge
tokens.usage: The phone frame's outer edge, separating the light bezel from the page.

families.sans: "Inter", "Inter Fallback", "Inter Fallback Roboto", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

fonts.unicodeRange: U+20A0-20C0 (currency signs: ₱ and the rest of the block)

fallback.note: Metric overrides so the swap from the local font to Inter barely moves text (Arial on Windows and Apple, Roboto on Android). Values follow Inter's published metrics against each face.

scale.name: display
scale.usage: The page's one statement (h1). 40 px at 360 wide → 72 px at 1440.

scale.name: headline
scale.usage: Section headings (h2). 32 → 48 px, as ApplyFast's 40–46 px h2 at 800.

scale.name: title-lg
scale.usage: Feature and chapter headings inside a section (h3 that leads a composition).

scale.name: title
scale.usage: Small headings (h3/h4) in lists, plans and the FAQ; ApplyFast's 17 px at 700.

scale.name: eyebrow
scale.usage: Uppercase label above a heading (13 px, +0.1em), as on ApplyFast.

scale.name: lede
scale.usage: The paragraph under a display or headline. 17 → 20 px.

scale.name: figure
scale.usage: Prices and large amounts; always tabular figures.

type.note: Typography-first, after the owner's ApplyFast site (2026-11-08): Inter at 800 with tight negative tracking for headings, uppercase tracked eyebrows, 1.6 body leading. ApplyFast names Inter but ships no web font; Lucento self-hosts it so every visitor gets the same face.

spacing.note: 4 px grid, numbered by multiples of 4. Two fluid tokens set the page rhythm.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label to value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to text; tight groups.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Related items in a list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inside small groups; legend rows.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Heading to its paragraph.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between columns; paragraph to actions.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section heading block to content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between major groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between sub-sections.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page side padding (≥ safe-area insets).

tokens.name: section
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a section (56 → 96 px; two adjacent sections never leave more than ~190 px of air).

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Longest line for running text: about 70 characters at 16 px (ch units overshoot here because the digits are wide).

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Widest content column (1216 px).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Legend swatches, small tags (app shapes.extraSmall).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Focus-ring rounding, table cells (app shapes.small).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Disclosure rows (app shapes.medium).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and plan cards (app shapes.large).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The horizon chart panel (app shapes.extraLarge).

tokens.name: radius-device
tokens.usage: Phone frame outside; the screen inside is 30px.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons (pills) and the sun.

shadow.note: Flat by default. Only the phone floats. Night separates by tone (card #17233F on paper #0B1229).

tokens.name: shadow-device
tokens.usage: The phone frame. Nothing else casts a shadow. Night adds a faint 1 px rim so the bezel keeps its edge on the navy page.

tokens.name: target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for every link and control (48 in the app).

tokens.name: button
tokens.usage: Button height (matches the app's 52dp).

tokens.name: phone
tokens.usage: Hero phone width on phones. From 900 px wide it also follows the viewport height (see horizon.css) so the whole hero fits above the fold.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline width; offset 3px.

motion.note: Mirrors the app (Mascot.kt, ANIMATION_ASSETS.md) via lab/src/motion/tokens.css. Reduced motion sets durations and distances to 0.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Entrances.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Hover and state changes.

tokens.name: ease-emphasised
tokens.usage: Emphasised moments (reserved).

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.usage: Hover, press, disclosure chevron.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Disclosure open, theme cross-fades.

tokens.name: dur-enter
tokens.usage: Section entrances (if any).

tokens.name: dur-hero
tokens.usage: The phone rising onto the ground: once per page load, wide screens only (where it is in view).

tokens.name: stagger
tokens.usage: Delay before the entrance; between items when several enter.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.usage: Two columns: hero copy beside the phone, chart beside its legend, three plan cards and privacy points in a row.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.usage: Wide: larger gaps only; no new layout.

meta.source: lucento-studio system/ (Phase 3, 2026-11-08). App references: Color.kt, Themes.kt (Sunrise light + dark), Type.kt, Dimens.kt; scenery panoramas from res/drawable-nodpi.
